newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso closes firm on swaps.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso closes firm on swaps.

text.p: Mexico's same-day peso rate closed slightly firmer on Friday at low volume following swaps ahead of the weekend, traders said.

"There hasn't been much happening in the market. The same-day market was liquid because of swaps, but the 48-hour peso has yet to weaken as many have yet to buy back dollars in that market," a trader said.
The same-day peso was 0.2 of a centavo firmer at 7.5210/7.5255 per dollar.

Dealers tend to sell dollars in the same-day market prior to a weekend, to buy them back at 24 and 48 hours, and thus not pay for them until next Monday or Tuesday, with pesos that may be invested in the money market in the meantime.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and 24-hour contracts were 0.6 of a centavo and 1.6 centavos weaker, respectively, at 7.5360/7.5390 and 7.5330/7.5360 per dollar.
